@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Sense and Sensibility, written by Jane Austen, is a classic of English l______e.
= literature
~詞義 literature（n.）文學
~原文 Sense and Sensibility, written by Jane Austen, is a classic of English literature.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The coach demanded strict o______e to team rules in order to ensure everyone stayed safe and cooperative.
= obedience
~詞義 obedience（n.）服從
~原文 The coach demanded strict obedience to team rules in order to ensure everyone stayed safe and cooperative.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: After a long search, the rescue team finally found the w______k of the plane.
= wreck
~詞義 wreck（n.）殘骸
~原文 After a long search, the rescue team finally found the wreck of the plane.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The boss was impressed by Tina's p______n and thought that she had explained her ideas very clearly.
= presentation
~詞義 presentation（n.）報告
~原文 The boss was impressed by Tina's presentation and thought that she had explained her ideas very clearly.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: When I eat pudding, I like to s______e some chocolate chips on it to give it more flavor.
= sprinkle
~詞義 sprinkle（v.）撒;灑
~原文 When I eat pudding, I like to sprinkle some chocolate chips on it to give it more flavor.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The engineer fixed a ______ problem in the car that had caused loud noises during driving.
A: remarkable
B: mountainous
C: philosophical
D: mechanical
= D
~詞義 mechanical（adj.）機械的
~原文 The engineer fixed a mechanical problem in the car that had caused loud noises during driving.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The pilots of the jet are equipped with ______ in case they have to jump out of the plane.
A: diplomats
B: mechanics
C: parachutes
D: syllables
= C
~詞義 parachute（n.）降落傘
~原文 The pilots of the jet are equipped with parachutes in case they have to jump out of the plane.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Traffic ______ include going above the speed limit and parking in a no-parking zone.
A: lobsters
B: regulations
C: ministers
D: violations
= D
~詞義 violation（n.）違反
~原文 Traffic violations include going above the speed limit and parking in a no-parking zone.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The government is going to make stricter rules ______ the use of chemicals in food.
A: regulating
B: violating
C: participating
D: murmuring
= A
~詞義 regulate（v.）規範;約束
~原文 The government is going to make stricter rules regulating the use of chemicals in food.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: It was not until Emily Dickinson died that she became famous in the ______ field.
A: remarkable
B: literary
C: muddy
D: pregnant
= B
~詞義 literary（adj.）文學的
~原文 It was not until Emily Dickinson died that she became famous in the literary field.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: shifted
B: pregnant
C: logic
D: remark
E: mechanic
F: loyalty

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: If someone makes an offensive ______ about you, you should speak up against it, or the person may do it again.
= D
~詞義 remark（n.）言論
~原文 If someone makes an offensive remark about you, you should speak up against it, or the person may do it again.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: I just don't understand the ______ behind May's decision. She wants to buy a membership for the sports club, but she doesn't like to exercise at all.
= C
~詞義 logic（n.）邏輯
~原文 I just don't understand the logic behind May's decision. She wants to buy a membership for the sports club, but she doesn't like to exercise at all.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: The region has ______ from farming to technology-based industries over the past decade.
= A
~詞義 shift（v.）轉移
~原文 The region has shifted from farming to technology-based industries over the past decade.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Before buying the second-hand car, John asked a ______ to check whether it was in good condition.
= E
~詞義 mechanic（n.）技工
~原文 Before buying the second-hand car, John asked a mechanic to check whether it was in good condition.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Jane's ______ to her friends made her stand by them even during difficult times.
= F
~詞義 loyalty（n.）忠誠
~原文 Jane's loyalty to her friends made her stand by them even during difficult times.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: registration
B: remarkable
C: protein
D: revised
E: muddy
F: violated

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Leave those ______ boots outside! I just mopped the floor.
= E
~詞義 muddy（adj.）泥濘的
~原文 Leave those muddy boots outside! I just mopped the floor.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The writer ______ his article, as many people had complained about the racist comments in the original version.
= D
~詞義 revise（v.）修改
~原文 The writer revised his article, as many people had complained about the racist comments in the original version.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The company ______ the law by selling customers' personal information to other companies.
= F
~詞義 violate（v.）違反
~原文 The company violated the law by selling customers' personal information to other companies.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Anyone who wants to sign up for evening classes at the community college has to fill in this ______ form.
= A
~詞義 registration（n.）登記;註冊
~原文 Anyone who wants to sign up for evening classes at the community college has to fill in this registration form.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: It was a ______ achievement for the young singer to win an American Music Award.
= B
~詞義 remarkable（adj.）傑出的
~原文 It was a remarkable achievement for the young singer to win an American Music Award.
